reviews.title: reliability and endurance are super great
reviews.comment: Seagate is one of my proffered companies.  my min systems are all SDD on a 2.5GBps network.  I have RAID-0 build with these on a storage server and they keep up with no sweat.  I've not had issues with Seagate drives or the company for the last 30+ years I've used them.
reviews.author: David Alan Holding

reviews.title: Working great! Good value
reviews.comment: Tested out great and I'm actively using it to store my files. Seems to have reasonable read/write speeds but wow it can be loud when waking up and when a file search is done. I'm glad it's in my server PC tucked away in my home office room closet, but it's definitely still audible like someone is tumbling a bunch of rocks back there.
